info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Summarys-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Summary API provides a detailed overview of items currently in users' shopping carts. This endpoint enables retrieval of summarized cart information, helping businesses analyze customer behavior and sales trends. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and analytics tools seeking to display or process cart data for reporting and user engagement. By leveraging this API, developers can improve user experience and drive conversions by tailoring offerings based on cart activities.

get.summary: Retrieve the summary of the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint provides a detailed summary of items currently in the user's shopping cart, including quantities and total price. This is useful for users to review their cart before proceeding to checkout.

requestBody.description: Request payload for retrieving the summary of the shopping cart. This should contain the necessary identifiers or parameters to fetch the user's current cart state.

ListEcommerceCartSummarysRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operations on the cart summary.

ListEcommerceCartSummarysResponse_200.title: Cart Summary Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cart summary operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cart operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cart operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cart summary request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the cart operation.

ListEcommerceCartSummarysResponse_200.description: Response schema for cart summary operations, providing the status and details of the cart.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the cart entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cart entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cart operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the cart operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A lower value indicates faster response processing.
